methods.what: Product of four theta functions with arguments x±y±z±t shifted by half periods, weighted by sign factors (-1)^{εε'} and summed over characteristics (Riemann theta addition/quartic relation)
Linear transformation conditions on coefficients α relative to period matrix a, defining λ
Sum over characteristics of products of theta functions with half-period shifts times exponential quadratic factors, expressed as a function f of the characteristic indices η, η'
